description: Deterministic PR description quality linter: flags a missing/too-short body, absent test evidence, absent stated rationale, an unstructured long body, and - only for PRs that look like bugfixes (title prefix fix/bug/hotfix/patch, or an explicit is_bugfix flag) - missing repro steps. Optionally requires a linked issue/ticket reference. Single PR only, no batch. Deterministic, no LLM.

pr.description: {title?, body?, is_bugfix?}. is_bugfix overrides title-based inference when supplied.

require_issue_link.description: Default false. When true, flags a missing issue/ticket reference in the title or body.

name: pr_description_lint
